skill.name: session-template
skill.description: Applies feature, bugfix, refactor, documentation, or security templates to AI session plans and customizes them with task-specific steps.
skill.summary: Create task-specific development plans from reusable session templates.
skill.author: Atyantik

content.value_statement: Complex development tasks often start without a complete, task-specific plan. This skill applies and customizes proven session templates for consistent execution.
actual_capabilities: Classifies tasks as feature, bugfix, refactor, documentation, or security work.
Loads bundled phase-based checklists for five common development task types.
Customizes generic checklist items with details from the current task.
Adds, renames, removes, and displays plan items through ai-update-plan.
Combines templates when a task spans multiple development workflows.
Includes testing, quality, documentation, and final review phases.
limitations: Requires compatible project session tools, including ai-update-plan, for plan updates.
Provides planning guidance but does not implement the requested code changes.
Bundled templates are generic and require adjustment for project-specific workflows.
Suggested quality gates may reference tools that are unavailable in some repositories.

use_cases.title: Plan a new feature
use_cases.description: Turn a feature request into phased research, testing, implementation, quality, documentation, and review tasks.

use_cases.title: Structure a bug investigation
use_cases.description: Create a focused workflow for reproduction, root cause analysis, regression testing, correction, and documentation.

use_cases.title: Coordinate a security fix
use_cases.description: Organize vulnerability assessment, impact analysis, secure implementation, hardening, testing, review, and disclosure planning.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a session template
prompt_templates.prompt: Select the best session template for this task: {task_description}. Explain the choice and create a focused plan.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when the task type is unclear.

prompt_templates.title: Apply a bugfix plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the bugfix template to {bug_description}. Customize each phase for the affected component and reported behavior.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when a reproducible defect needs a complete correction workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Combine development workflows
prompt_templates.prompt: Combine the {primary_template} and {secondary_template} templates for {task_description}. Remove duplicate steps and preserve every relevant quality gate.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when one task spans multiple workflow types.

prompt_templates.title: Build a constrained execution plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a customized {template_type} plan for {task_description}. Respect {project_constraints}, assign concrete deliverables, and identify dependencies and validation criteria for every phase.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for complex work with repository-specific constraints and acceptance criteria.

output_examples.input: Plan a feature that adds OAuth2 authentication.
output: Research existing authentication and provider integration points.
Write tests for login, callback, token refresh, and failure cases.
Implement the feature, run quality checks, update documentation, and complete final review.

output_examples.input: Create a plan for an intermittent memory leak in the data processor.
output: Reproduce the leak and record memory growth conditions.
Trace allocations, confirm the root cause, and add a failing regression test.
Implement a focused fix, run the full test suite, and document the correction.

output_examples.input: Plan a security correction that also restructures the authentication module.
output: Selected templates: Security Fix and Refactoring
Assess exposure and establish passing baseline tests before structural changes.
Add a security regression test, apply the correction, and refactor incrementally.
Complete hardening, authorization checks, quality verification, and security documentation.

best_practices: Apply the template early, then replace generic steps with concrete repository details.
Remove irrelevant tasks and add missing acceptance criteria before implementation begins.
Update plan items as discoveries change scope, dependencies, or validation needs.
anti_patterns: Do not keep every template item when it does not apply to the task.
Do not treat the generated plan as proof that tests or quality checks passed.
Do not combine templates without removing duplicate phases and conflicting instructions.

faq.question: Which task types are supported?
faq.answer: The bundled templates cover feature development, bug fixes, refactoring, documentation, and security corrections.

faq.question: Can the skill choose a template automatically?
faq.answer: Yes. It classifies the task description and recommends the closest bundled workflow.

faq.question: Does the skill change application code?
faq.answer: No. It creates and updates session plans; implementation remains a separate activity.

faq.question: Can I customize generated plan items?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow supports adding, renaming, removing, and completing plan items.

faq.question: Can I combine more than one template?
faq.answer: Yes. Complex tasks can combine templates, but duplicate phases should be consolidated.

faq.question: What tools does the workflow require?
faq.answer: Plan updates require ai-update-plan. Some examples also reference uv, ai-start-task, make, Bandit, and project-specific review tools.
